### Template variables

Variables you provide when running the template — `DATA_ROOT` via `--data-root`, the rest via `--var NAME=value`:

| Variable | Required | Description |
|---|:--:|---|
| `DATA_ROOT` | ✓ | Root directory containing chipseq output (bwa/, fastqc/, trim_galore/, multiqc/, pipeline_info/) plus the reprocessed multiqc/multiqc_data/multiqc.parquet. |

### Data collections

**Origin** tells you whether a collection is *real pipeline data* or a reshape of it: <span class="gtd-badge gtd-direct">direct</span> = a pipeline output (scanned, or a recipe that reads raw files); <span class="gtd-badge gtd-derived">derived</span> = a recipe that reshapes one or more *direct* collections into the layout a visualization needs (no new measurement). **Reads** shows what produces it: a <span class="gtd-badge gtd-recipe">recipe</span> `.py` transform, or a raw <span class="gtd-badge gtd-file">file</span> scanned off disk. (A `direct` collection can still have a recipe — one that merely parses/cleans the raw file; `derived` means the recipe reshapes another collection.)

### Recipes

Each recipe reshapes raw pipeline output into a tidy table. The name links to its source; *Output* lists the validated `EXPECTED_SCHEMA` columns.

| Recipe | Transforms | Output |
|---|---|---|
| [`deeptools/fingerprint_metrics.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/deeptools/fingerprint_metrics.py) | Per-sample deepTools fingerprint metrics, one row per library. | `sample`, `auc`, `synthetic_auc`, `auc_ratio`, `x_intercept`, `synthetic_x_intercept`, `elbow_point`, `synthetic_elbow_point`, `synthetic_js_distance` |
| [`deeptools/plot_profile.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/deeptools/plot_profile.py) | deepTools metagene profile in long form, one row per sample and bin. | `sample`, `group`, `bin`, `bin_label`, `signal` |
| [`deseq2/results_long.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/deseq2/results_long.py) | Long DESeq2 results table, one row per (contrast, feature). | `contrast`, `gene_id`, `base_mean`, `log2fc`, `lfc_se`, `pvalue`, `padj`, `log2_base_mean`, `neg_log10_padj`, `significant`, `direction` |
| [`homer/annotate_peaks.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/homer/annotate_peaks.py) | Tidy HOMER ``annotatePeaks.pl`` output into a per-peak annotation table. | `sample`, `peak_id`, `chr`, `start`, `end`, `strand`, `peak_score`, `annotation_class`, `annotation`, `distance_to_tss`, `nearest_promoter_id`, `gene_name`, `gene_type` |
| [`homer/tss_distance_profile.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/homer/tss_distance_profile.py) | Where each sample's peaks sit relative to the nearest TSS, pre-binned. | `sample`, `distance_to_tss`, `peak_count`, `fraction` |
| [`macs2/consensus_boolean.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/macs2/consensus_boolean.py) | Consensus peak x sample presence matrix from MACS2 consensus boolean tables. | `peak_id`, `consensus_set`, `interval_id`, `chr`, `start`, `end`, `num_peaks`, `num_samples` |
| [`macs2/consensus_fc.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/macs2/consensus_fc.py) | Fold-enrichment matrix of the strongest MACS2 consensus peaks. | `peak_id`, `consensus_set`, `interval_id`, `chr`, `region`, `support` |
| [`macs2/peak_summary.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/macs2/peak_summary.py) | Per-sample MACS2 peak QC: call count, FRiP score and peak-metric spreads. | `sample`, `num_peaks`, `frip_score`, `width_median`, `width_mean`, `width_max`, `fold_enrichment_median`, `fold_enrichment_mean`, `neg_log10_qvalue_median`, `neg_log10_pvalue_median` |
| [`macs2/peaks.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/macs2/peaks.py) | Concatenate MACS2 narrowPeak calls into one tidy peak table. | `sample`, `peak_id`, `chr`, `start`, `end`, `width`, `summit`, `score`, `fold_enrichment`, `neg_log10_pvalue`, `neg_log10_qvalue` |
| [`preseq/complexity_curve.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/preseq/complexity_curve.py) | Library complexity curve with its confidence ribbon, one row per read depth. | `sample`, `total_reads`, `expected_distinct`, `lower_ci`, `upper_ci`, `ci_width` |
